status: Declared before this revision's results; retrospective development
scope: P4 only; four existing priority shapes; CPU-only development
execution_interpretation: Counts come from the archived SM80 64x(128*g)x32 serial-split-K implementation. CTA rounds are a one-CTA-per-SM proxy, not measured occupancy. Output bytes are logical tensor accesses, not HBM traffic. Coefficients remain empirical log-ratio parameters, not identified physical service times.

fit.scaling: training-only, workload-equal; only gate columns centered

inference.group_support: unchanged exact M/q plus observed K/N bounds

evaluation.primary: leave original M/N sweep group out
evaluation.mean_and_max: no worse than fixed, old relative and previous joint model
evaluation.sensitivity: exact linear-response LP and independent refit; diagnostic, no assumed noise distribution

stop_rule: Evaluate these three variants once. Do not tune features, ridge, thresholds or choose a different proposed model after viewing results. Preserve failures.
